custom_fields.m:
[[[ return `
◆${variables.title}◆
`; ]]]

deco_tile.state_display: [[[ if (entity && entity.state === 'on' && entity.attributes.brightness) return Math.round(entity.attributes.brightness/2.55) + '%'; if (entity && entity.attributes.volume_level !== undefined && entity.state !== 'off') return (entity.state.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+entity.state.slice(1)) + ' · ' + Math.round(entity.attributes.volume_level*100) + '%'; return helpers.localize(entity); ]]]

card.background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 0%, rgba(201,164,76,.22), rgba(201,164,76,.04) 60%, transparent), var(--ha-card-background)

deco_marker.extra_styles: ha-card::after, ha-card::before { display: none !important; } @media (max-width: 600px) { #name { display: none !important; } ha-card { width: 30px !important; } }

card.opacity: [[[ if (!entity || entity.state !== 'on') return 0; const b = entity.attributes.brightness; return b ? (0.35 + 0.65 * b / 255).toFixed(2) : 1; ]]]

deco_theme_toggle.name: [[[ const lite = entity && entity.state === 'deco_noir_lite'; return `Theme · ${lite ? 'Deco Noir Lite' : 'Deco Noir'} — tap for ${lite ? 'Noir' : 'Lite'}`; ]]]
